newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Telebras says to pay out dividends.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Telebras says to pay out dividends.

text.p: Shareholders of Brazilian federal telecoms giant Telebras have approved the payment of dividends of 1.878 reais per lot of 1,000 shares, the company said.
Telebras said the dividends will be paid to owners of Telebras' blue-chip preferred and its common shares on June 30, 1997.
Shareholders approved the payout, which was recommended by management, at a meeting on Tuesday.
Telebras, which holds 28 local operating subsidiaries and long-distance monopoly Embratel, is slated to be broken up and privatized starting late this year.
Government officials hope to complete the selloff of the federal giant by the end of 1998.
Telebras' preferred share trades on the New York Stock Exchange as a level three American Depositary Receipt (ADR).
